question: In September 2020, the Government of Australia appointed former cricketer Matthew Hayden and Indian origin politician ______ as trade envoys for advancing business ties with India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lisa Singh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In September 2020, The Australian__ government has appointed former cricketer Matthew Hayden and Indian-origin politician Lisa Singh as trade envoys for advancing business ties with India.
 
• Three new appointments to the board of the Australia-India Council were announced on 31 August 2020.
 
• Ashok Jacob has been reappointed as chair and will be joined by three new board members.
